feature_blocks: | GameSession | 1→N TablePhoto, ComponentMap, PhaseStep, CoachMessage | AtomicCodableStore |
| TablePhoto | N→1 GameSession；本地 image refs | AtomicCodableStore + files |
| ComponentDraft | 未确认组件/阶段 | AtomicCodableStore |
| ComponentMap | 确认后的组件清单 | AtomicCodableStore |
| PhaseStep | 确认后的回合步骤 | AtomicCodableStore |
| SetupOverlay | 确认后的分区标注 | AtomicCodableStore |
| CoachTurn / CoachMessage | 草稿 → 确认后历史 | AtomicCodableStore |
target_user: 用 iPhone 在实体桌边摆台、需要规则裁决与摆台步骤提示的桌游玩家 / 桌主（双手常扶组件与规则书）。
user_problem: 桌游开局前拍/导入规则书与桌面 → AI 识别组件与回合阶段草稿 → Keep 落成 ComponentMap / PhaseStep / SetupOverlay → 同一局里用桌面分区卡与回合步骤条推进 → 需要时聊天问裁决、在分区叠图上确认标注、TTS 边摆边讲；双手摆台时可口述规则问题写入教练会话。
value_proposition: RuleCue is an AI board-game rules and setup coach: snap or import rulebook and table photos, keep reviewed components and turn steps, chat for rulings, confirm annotated zone overlays, and hear TTS table-host cues while you set up.
